      top.innerHTML = `<span>${escapeText(r.label)}</span><span><b style="font-weight:500">${escapeText(format(r.spent))}</b> <span style="color:var(--muted,#5f6368)">of ${escapeText(format(r.planned))} · </span><span style="color:${over ? 'var(--negative,#c4242a)' : 'var(--muted,#5f6368)'}">${escapeText(note(r))}</span></span>`;
